data_output.description: encode(splits) returns (encoded, total_dimension). encoded remains a mapping for train, valid, and test whose values are (features, labels, users). features is int32 with shape (rows, 8) in exactly this column order: user_id, video_id, author_id, tab, dur_bucket, hour, weekday, tab_hour. tab_hour is row[4] + "\t" + str(math.floor(float(row[7]) / 100)); its vocabulary is fitted on train only and later-split unseen values map to its unknown bucket. labels and users retain their existing types and source-row alignment.

model_input.description: Model receives the encoded int32 feature matrix of shape (batch_rows, 8), where every value is a globally offset categorical index in [0, total_dimension). Model behavior is unchanged and must score all eight fields, including their FM interactions.
